headline: Governance-as-Code paper reports executable EU AI Act checks tested on two systems
summary: Paul and Nandy's arXiv paper presents Governance-as-Code, a framework of 43 machine-checkable Rego acceptance criteria across six modules for selected EU AI Act obligations affecting generative systems. It makes operational thresholds and proxies explicit and emits Article-indexed audit evidence. In two author-reported case studies, the framework reproduced findings from manual expert audits; the authors report 12 findings reproduced across the cases and an 18-hour versus 72-hour chatbot audit. These results are paper-reported, not independently validated.
